Not directly comparable to Bench2Drive, Fail2Drive, Waymo Motion or Waymo operational outcome data.

NVIDIA describes Alpamayo models as cloud-side teacher models, not in-vehicle runtimes; use this 34B model as a teacher/reasoning/data-generation comparator and evaluate edge deployment under a separate hardware, memory, power, precision and p95/p99 latency budget.

protocol.hosted_card_paper_count_difference: Unresolved: paper says 200 evaluation samples per track; current HF README card says 222 examples per track and the page shows 22,866 rows. Pin dataset repo revision and split/sample IDs; do not assume these counts describe the same unit/release.
protocol.open_domain_sources: internet-sourced driving video across global regions
protocol.inference_video_shape: 101 frames at 10 fps, 576x1024 per upstream repository example

caveats: ICLR 2026 paper reports 400 evaluation clips (200 per track); current Hugging Face dataset card lists 222 eval examples per track and the dataset page displays 22,866 rows. Resolve dataset commit, split semantics and sample IDs before reproduction.
The benchmark measures video distribution, visual quality, temporal/agent consistency and trajectory alignment. It does not evaluate downstream planner task success or closed-loop driving outcomes.

Ego and agent trajectories are derived through visual SLAM/depth/detection pipelines; they are not direct ground-truth measurements for every video frame. Report extraction failures and estimator uncertainty.

Open-domain track draws on internet-sourced videos. Code repository declares Apache-2.0 and dataset card declares Apache-2.0, but preserve source provenance and review third-party footage rights / dataset terms before commercial use or redistribution.
Sub-Saharan Africa is 5.4% of the paper's open-domain geographic mix; this is not country-specific South African coverage and does not demonstrate right-hand-drive / left-hand-traffic coverage.
FVD / visual preference scores alone do not establish metric physical correctness, controllability, causal actor response, decision value or safety.
All figures are author-reported; SAM has not reproduced this benchmark.

benchmarks.name: HiDrive
benchmarks.score_definition: Per route: DS_i = RC_i * LS_i * ES_i. Split-level DS is mean_i(DS_i); split-level RC and LS are means over all valid routes; split-level ES is averaged only over the ethics-applicable route subset.
caveats: Report RC/LS/ES separately; DS is a product.
Repository says academic research only unless commercial permission is obtained.
EthicsScore is benchmark-defined, not universal ethical truth.
Do not multiply the published aggregate RC, LS and ES columns to reconstruct aggregate DS; DS is averaged after per-route multiplication and ES has a subset denominator.
The paper's table includes nine baselines: TCP, UniAD-Base, VAD, ThinkTwice, DriveAdapter, DriveTransformer, ORION, DiffusionDrive, SimLingo and KnowVal.

aggregation.implication: Aggregate DS is not generally equal to aggregate RC * aggregate LS * aggregate ES because the product is taken per route before averaging, and ES can use a different denominator.

metric_semantics: RC is usually passed-waypoints / total-waypoints, but selected dilemma scenarios may set RC=1 after their safety-critical primary objective is completed.
LS is affected by legal events, collisions and route-lane events; it is not a pure traffic-law-only score.
Brake-aware relief changes selected collision penalty coefficients when braking occurred within the declared two-frame window.
ES includes social/normative events and its split-level mean is computed only over ethics-applicable routes.

Use the official split, camera inputs, rater labels, trajectory horizon and evaluator revision; don't infer missing labels or compare data-privileged methods against sensor-limited methods without a separate track.

Do not infer public-road safety, physical sensor qualification, or counterfactual correctness from benchmark performance.

prospective_targets.bench2drive-v0.0.4: Exceed the strongest reproduced DS without regressing SR, efficiency, comfort or scenario-family outcomes.
prospective_targets.hidrive-2026: Improve DS without regression in RC, LS or ES; report all 30 ability categories; require commercial authorization before commercial asset use.
prospective_targets.fail2drive-2026: At least 25% lower relative paired OOD degradation than strongest reproduced baseline with ID SR within 1 percentage point.
prospective_targets.colt-drive-2026: Exceed 60.8% action-pair accuracy at matched split/input privilege and report worst rare-object-family errors.
prospective_targets.driving-world-model-counterfactual-2026: At least +0.15 absolute event recovered fraction over direct prediction on exact same cases, with identity/timing/geometry non-inferior.
prospective_targets.mrsq-icml-2026: Reduce search-induced optimism/regret at matched compute without worsening tail performance, feasibility or deadlines.
prospective_targets.navsim_v2_epdms_2026: Reproduce the current strongest matched EPDMS baseline first; then improve the aggregate and individual NC/DAC/DDC/TLC/EP/TTC/LK/HC/EC dimensions on sealed slices without worsening worst-family results.
prospective_targets.reactsim_bench_2026: Beat strongest reproduced actor-world-model baselines on matched ego-deviation inputs, preserving AV-agent risk, agent-agent collision, off-road, direction and kinematic feasibility metrics separately; qualify reciprocal online interaction separately.
prospective_targets.sam-traffic-convention-mirror-v0.1: 100% of exact paired geometric/control sign invariants; 100% of missing/stale/map-rule-mismatch negatives reject or remain unresolved; 0 silent inference of traffic side from steering-wheel layout, GPS, map appearance or image pixel orientation.
prospective_targets.drivinggen_iclr_2026: Reproduce the exact 400-paper-sample or separately frozen hosted-card release with pinned sample IDs, then improve worst-stratum scene/agent temporal consistency, automotive imaging quality, trajectory feasibility and ego-control alignment without regressions. Add a distinct decision-value experiment: counterfactual planner outcome and reactive-agent response under matched action/call budgets; do not treat visual scores as downstream safety.
prospective_targets.nuplan_r_2026: Reproduce the exact nuPlan-R Diffusion-Planner Test14-Hard baseline first. Stretch target: +2 CLS points and +2 percentage points Success Rate at matched settings, with no regression in All-Core Pass Rate, worst-family collision/off-road, agent realism/diversity or p99 latency. All thresholds are prospective and require paired family-cluster uncertainty intervals.

global_rules: No composite score across non-comparable benchmark families.
Author-reported, secondary-board, independently-reproduced and SAM-reproduced result states remain distinct.
A public code license does not automatically grant dataset/asset rights.
Missing, timeout, censored and unsupported scenarios remain in the denominator with typed status.
Benchmark adapters do not constitute benchmark reproduction.
All target thresholds are prospective, not measured Symthaea results.
NAVSIM v2 is a non-reactive pseudo-simulation profile; do not describe it as fully interactive closed-loop traffic simulation.
ReactSim-Bench evaluates surrounding-agent responses to pre-generated ego deviations; it is not a complete reciprocal online ego/actor policy loop.
System architecture references (for example Autoware 2.0) are not benchmark results and are stored separately from benchmark entries.

SAM-developed synthetic conformance crucibles are stored separately from external benchmark leaderboard records; a passing synthetic suite is not external benchmark reproduction or physical-safety evidence.

nuPlan-R is a reciprocal reactive loop at the planner/actor layer, but interaction-selected top-k agents receive diffusion rollouts while remaining agents follow log replay; distinguish this from all-agent reciprocal re-planning and from physical vehicle validation.

World-model benchmark-landscape counts are cross-domain taxonomy data, not driving-only counts; preserve target-specific denominators and distinguish closed-loop protocol from downstream outcome metrics.

SAM-developed Follow oracle/observation-domain experiments remain in internal_conformance_crucibles until exact-head tests and frozen scenario/action metrics are executed; no authored test is a result.
WOD-E2E is an open-loop expert-preference / long-tail trajectory benchmark; RFS is not a closed-loop safety or counterfactual outcome metric.

Different secondary leaderboard pages for WOD-E2E are distinct benchmark views until exact split, label, evaluator and submission protocols are proven identical; never compare scores across those views directly.

internal_conformance_crucibles.name: SAM Follow Oracle / Student-Teacher Privilege Separation v0.3

protocol.ego_time_policy: select latest peer history snapshot at or before ego observation time; never future

training_information_flow.privileged_teacher_target: typed SimulatorOracleFollowTarget may be consumed by PD teacher

protocol.action_difference_metric: mean absolute delta across steering/throttle/brake, named student_teacher_action_delta_l1

frozen_evaluation.shadow_teacher: optional telemetry-only reference; teacher_action_evaluation_only=true and teacher_action_reference_only=true; never blended or supervised
frozen_evaluation.simulator_oracle: may be retained for outcome/reward scoring; must not influence the policy
frozen_evaluation.interpretation: No teacher-driven or gradient-based parameter updates; recurrent state and declared FEP runtime modulation remain active inference-time behavior.

caveats: The student still consumes the existing simulated 20D VehicleState, including synthetic mesh-derived peer channels; this is not local sensor-only input.
A zero PD action blend in curriculum Phase 4 does not mean teacher-free learning: BPTT supervision may still consume the teacher on train_every steps.
Frozen evaluation removes the explicit PD/oracle teacher from blending, BPTT supervision, replay updates and exploration noise; it can compute a shadow teacher only for evaluator telemetry.
Simulator truth may remain available to score outcomes, but the student policy must not consume the explicit Follow oracle target.
The evaluation path still uses the bicycle-model simulator and existing simulated state vector; it does not establish a camera/LiDAR/radar-only perception result.
Exact-head CI and tests for the latest implementation are not yet confirmed; authored tests and source audit are not counted as passes.
This internal synthetic training/evaluation crucible is not an external leaderboard result or road-safety measure.
Episode CSV currently has 37 named columns; a regression checks every emitted row has the same width as its header. This is an authored test and source-authoring check, not yet an executed Rust pass.

Frozen evaluation does not freeze recurrent hidden state or FEP time-constant modulation: these inference-time dynamics remain active. The tested immutability property is output-projection equality and absence of BPTT/replay update calls, not static hidden state.

caveats: Specification only. No Follow campaign result, test pass or performance result is claimed.

This is an internal SAM experiment, not an external leaderboard or a vehicle safety demonstration.
